Callout.Name: Multiple Casualties - Shots
Callout.Message: Two people shot in the street.
Callout.Advisory: One walking wounded, one on the ground.

Script.Line: We were both outside. It all happened at once.
I got down behind the car. He did not get down in time.
Do not leave him. Whatever else you do, do not leave him.

Callout.Patient: I am fine. Help them first. Help them.

Lines.Approach: One walking and one not. The walking one is not the priority, whatever they say.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
